d: Company Description Top Group Holding Co. is a diversified organization committed to excellence across real estate, home furnishings, fashion, and lifestyle. The company focuses on redefining luxury living and elevating lifestyle experiences in Kuwait and the broader region. Through its varied portfolio, Top Group Holding offers innovative, high-quality products and services that enrich everyday life. Team members join an ambitious, growth-oriented environment where creativity, customer focus, and continuous improvement are encouraged.

Role Description The Market Research Analyst is a full-time, on-site role based in the Kuwait City Metropolitan Area. This role is responsible for collecting, organizing, and analyzing market and consumer data to support strategic decisions across the company’s business lines. Day-to-day tasks include designing and conducting market research studies, preparing reports and dashboards, and identifying trends, opportunities, and risks in target markets. The Market Research Analyst will work closely with cross-functional teams to translate insights into actionable recommendations, support forecasting and business planning, and present findings clearly to stakeholders. The role requires consistent collaboration with internal teams and external partners to ensure data-driven strategies that align with business objectives.
q: Candidates should possess strong skills in Market Research and Market Analysis to evaluate industries, competitors, and consumer behavior.
Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills and Research abilities to interpret quantitative and qualitative data and develop meaningful insights.
Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to present complex findings clearly, both in writing and verbally, to diverse stakeholders.
Proficiency with data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, BI tools, statistical software) and survey platforms is highly beneficial.
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, Statistics, or a related field is preferred.
Experience in market or business analytics, preferably within real estate, retail, or lifestyle sectors, is an advantage.
Strong attention to detail, ability to manage multiple projects, and a collaborative working style are important for success in this role.
